properties.title: Philippines M6.6 Earthquake (GDACS Orange)
properties.summary: M6.6 at 10km depth, Sarangani/Davao Occidental. Aftershock of June 8 M7.8. Phivolcs reported Intensity V in Kiamba. 590,000 population exposure.

properties.title: Japan M5.7 near Oshino
properties.summary: M5.7 earthquake near Oshino, Japan on June 27 UTC.

properties.title: Afghanistan M6.1 Earthquake
properties.summary: M6.1 at 208km depth June 27 UTC. Deep focus limits surface damage. 140,000 population exposed to MMI IV.

properties.title: Japan M5.8 near Iwate
properties.summary: M5.8 earthquake near Iwate Prefecture Japan. 27.8M people exposed to MMI IV.

properties.title: Ufa Oil Refineries Strike (FIRMS thermal)
properties.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes hit two of three Ufa refineries (Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim, Bashneft-Novoil). Combined 22M ton/yr capacity. 870 miles from Ukraine border. Thermal anomaly confirmed.

properties.title: Orenburg Gas Processing Plant Strike
properties.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Russia's only helium plant in Orenburg region. Also produces ethane used in solid rocket fuel. 1,200+ km from frontline. Ukrainian General Staff confirmed.

properties.title: Crimea State of Emergency Declared
properties.summary: Russian-installed Aksyonov declared emergency. Power outages in Sevastopol, fuel shortages, tourism suspended, children's camps closed. Follow-on Ukrainian infrastructure strikes.

properties.title: Russian Strike on Zaporizhzhia (Jun 29)
properties.summary: Russian strike killed 2 people including a 53-year-old woman, injured 17 civilians in Zaporizhzhia city.

properties.title: Venezuela Twin Earthquakes M7.2+M7.5
properties.summary: M7.2 foreshock then M7.5 mainshock 39 seconds apart on June 24-25. San Felipe, Yaracuy epicenter. 1,430+ dead, 68,900+ missing, 3,238 injured. USGS models potential 100,000 deaths. La Guaira port disrupted.

properties.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Disruption
properties.summary: Iran enforcing Tehran-approved routing. 45 incidents since US-Iran war. June 25 ceasefire breach incident. Reuters: 35 vessels preparing to cross June 27. Bloomberg: 3 ships turned back via Oman route.

properties.title: IDF Airstrikes Gaza (ongoing)
properties.summary: Israeli airstrikes on Gaza City and Al-Maghazi camp June 26. Israeli child killed. Reduced-intensity operations continuing post-ceasefire framework.

properties.title: Israeli strikes in Lebanon (ongoing)
properties.summary: Israeli warplanes conducted 6 airstrikes in southern Lebanon in the past week. Strike near Zawtar and Mayfadoun killed 3, injured 1. Hezbollah drone airbase discovered underground near Israel border.

properties.title: Typhoon Mekkhala (Extratropical Jun 27)
properties.summary: Former Category 4 (145mph peak). Two deaths in Taiwan, three in Japan. Strongest June typhoon in 22 years. Extratropical by June 27.
